upstream_recipe.section: ### 3.3 Multi-GPU presets: '2 GPUs, long sequences' + ### 3.2 Configuration Tips (on >=130 GiB GPUs pass the served shape via --warmup-resolutions / --warmup-num-frames)

cb-sgl-cookbook.notes: The 2-GPU preset plus the warmup shape the cookbook tells >=130 GiB GPUs to pass. Forward count unverified: the cookbook says 'a short refinement' without a number.

cb-sgl-cookbook-preset.notes: The preset alone. On >=130 GiB GPUs breakable CUDA graphs turn on and the default warmup shape is the sampling default 960x544, which two-stage cannot halve to a 64-aligned size (warmup_request_builder._resolve_default_warmup_resolution at 3a01d4cc): expected to fail to start on H200/B200 until that is fixed.
